changes.text: T-WLA: the repository README links checkpoints on Hugging Face for the visual policy (1.6 GB), the RGB world head (375.6 MB), a pretrained EgoTouch H8 tactile encoder and three baselines; the trained tactile editor is not linked. Weights not_released -> released; the 2026-11-24 read had received an empty README.

HOPE: the repository README links a trained checkpoint on Google Drive (hope_checkpoint.tar, not downloaded) and states CC BY-NC 4.0. Weights not_released -> released; license not stated -> CC BY-NC 4.0.

Dex-X: the repository's checkpoints/ folder holds a point-cloud student with tactile points (1.8 MB) and two state teachers (3.0 MB each); the README says the release simulation differs from the one they were trained in. Weights not_released -> released.
ViTacFormer: the repository README links an example data zip on Google Drive (not opened); it links no checkpoint, so weights stay not_released.

TransDex: the repository README, recorded earlier as empty, gives training steps, links no checkpoint and says an example pretraining dataset will be released on Google Drive later; weights stay not_released.
